text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh, I'm getting nervous as if it were 
my own race...! Will Ikuno be okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Who knows... But hey, she's way calmer 
than us, so maybe she's surprisingly 
composed about it?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Ikuno is always cool and 
collected! So right about now, her engine 
must be burning super hot!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ya can't really call that keepin' your 
cool, now can ya...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Go, Ikuno-o-o! Open up the Ikuno Engine 
full throttle and leave 'em in the dust~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It will be starting soon, won't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-san. Please, etch your running 
powerfully into Hanshin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Unlike me, who had to give up on the 
Japanese Derby because of these legs of 
mine... you should be able to do it—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa~, look at the crowd for the Oka Sho 
again this year! Now this is what Classic 
racing is all about~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so looking forward to this! I wonder 
how in shape everyone is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooooh...—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(When I close my eyes, all I hear is the 
roar of the crowd gathered at Hanshin 
Racecourse, and—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (My heart, beating slightly faster...)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I'll show them. I'll show them my 
running.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Deep inhaaaale... Long exhaaale... 
—Alright. I'm definitely gonna win...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...It really is different after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even among GⅠ races, the Classics... feel 
even more stifling and intense.
choice_data_list:
Maybe that's the weight of a 
once-in-a-lifetime moment.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In other words, this intense pressure 
is proof of just how special it is...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Let us etch this into our very being 
with all our might. Today's 
once-in-a-lifetime race.
choice_data_list:
I'll be waiting for you to come back safe 
and sound.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone is in magnificent shape. And 
their determination is simply tremendous.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...I shall pray right here and now. That 
every Umamusume running today may give it 
her all safely.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(And I will remember everyone running 
alongside me today, forever—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now— Towards the first Tiara...!
